$note: EXAMPLE data. Copy to recall.json and replace with your own. One line = a short pointer (path, count, command), never a content and never a secret value. Adding an asset or a problem = adding an entry here; the registry is rendered from this file by recall_hook.py --render.

assets.line: MAIL ARCHIVE: /srv/mail-archive on host-a (written by mail-sync.service every 20 min); full-text index in Postgres container pg, table public.mail_chunks. Cite message id, subject and date; never copy a message.
WHERE THINGS ARE: CATALOGUE.md (databases, archives, rights, who writes them), regenerated every morning on each host by data-catalogue.timer. Read it BEFORE searching.
BOT MEMORY: SQLite /var/lib/bot-memory/memory.sqlite, MCP server on 127.0.0.1 (scoped-memory.service); automatic recall in the gateway hook.
MODELS: probe results in /var/lib/model-probe/probe_<time>.json (06:20 and 18:20, model-probe.timer); gateway config /etc/litellm/config.yaml.

problems.symptom: An asset exists but no map or inventory lists it.
problems.cause: The map only measured services, ports and timers, never data; and nothing regenerated it.
problems.solution: Data catalogue measured every day on each host; this recall injects the right pointer.

problems.cause: systemctl start returns 0 without running anything on a oneshot unit that is already active; inactive is not failed.
problems.solution: The proof of a run is a NEW ARTEFACT (a commit, a file, a dated log line), never a return code.

problems.pattern: couldn'?t generate a response|bot (is )?(silent|not answering|does not answer)
problems.symptom: A bot answers "I couldn't generate a response" or nothing at all.
problems.cause: Two MCP servers attached to the same agent exposed the SAME tool name; the platform dropped the turn before calling the model. Other causes seen: a reasoning model cut by max_tokens (empty content), a dead model.
problems.solution: List the tools of every MCP server of the agent and look for duplicates; then check the model probe.

problems.symptom: A model disappears and we learn it afterwards.
problems.cause: No probe per usage; a working fallback hides the dead model.
problems.solution: model_probe.py with fallbacks disabled: SEVERE = used, dead, and no live fallback.

problems.symptom: A secret appears in an output or a log.
problems.cause: Masking by FIELD NAME, or only at the first level of a nested structure.
problems.solution: Mask by VALUE SHAPE, recursively; never pass a secret as a command-line argument.
problems.guard: SECRET_SHAPE in data_catalogue.py refuses to write

problems.pattern: does not exist|doesn'?t exist|there is no|not found|nowhere
problems.symptom: The agent asserts that something does not exist, and it does.
problems.cause: A truncated search, or a search in the wrong place, turned into a general conclusion.
problems.solution: Write "not at <the exact place looked at>" and NAME the place; read the catalogue first.
